subject: Vent shrimp
topic: This whole tower is moving, because it's covered in shrimp.
script:
This whole tower is moving, because it's covered in shrimp.
Thousands of vent shrimp swarm over an eight-meter-tall spire in the Caribbean.
NOAA filmed it in twenty eleven, at the Von Damm vent field, along the Mid-Cayman Rise.
Hydrothermal vents like this blast out hot, mineral-rich water from beneath the seafloor.
Bacteria use those chemicals for energy, and the shrimp feed on them.
These shrimp don't have normal eyes.
Instead, scientists think a light-sensing patch on their backs may detect the faint glow of hot vents.
On that same expedition, scientists found the first live vent tubeworm ever seen in the Atlantic.
Would you get close to this tower?
